defaults.production_acceleration: no completion in the turn a job starts; no resource or entity duplication
defaults.exclusive_creatures: All Balrogs and Dragon forms obey only Melkor; allied movement, rally and transport powers cannot issue or revise their orders. Worldbreaker calls existing living IDs, Dark Architect may also produce new ones

profiles.compensates: Sparse messenger and convoy-coordination infrastructure.

field_power.name: Skyhand
field_power.effect: Push one exposed formation a short distance; cannot push it across lethal edges or into impassable terrain.
field_power.range: Visible local encounter; one formation
field_power.duration: One pulse after a visible wind-up
field_power.counter: Brace behind anchored cover, interrupt the wind-up, or spread formations.

support_power.name: Heralds on the Wind
support_power.effect: Relay one convoy's warning and revised route without a staffed relay building; movement, escorts and cargo remain ordinary.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment; existing convoy crew and supplies
support_power.range: One connected region; one existing convoy
support_power.duration: One week
support_power.counter: Break the route, conceal an ambush, or force competing emergencies.

passive.name: Clear Signals
passive.effect: Nearby allied formations recover coordination after receiving verified orders.
passive.limit: Once per formation per encounter; no extra actions or immunity to fear.

profiles.retained_weakness: Cannot replace roads, cargo capacity, food production or multiple relay networks.

profiles.compensates: Limited observation-post coverage.

field_power.name: Unclouded Flash
field_power.effect: Expose concealed silhouettes in one illuminated patch; does not reveal intentions, inventories or enemies behind solid walls.
field_power.range: One visible local patch
field_power.counter: Use solid cover, smoke, tunnels or movement beyond the lit patch.

support_power.name: Starwatch Circuit
support_power.effect: Provide intermittent reports of exposed movement along one surveyed route without constructing its watchtowers.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment; maintained survey records
support_power.range: One connected region; one route
support_power.duration: One week
support_power.counter: Travel under cover, sever the route, or send decoys; reports remain dated observations.

passive.name: Steady Bearing
passive.effect: Nearby travelers resist one navigation delay on already surveyed ground.
passive.limit: Once per journey; cannot bypass terrain, danger or supply costs.

profiles.retained_weakness: Observation yields neither production capacity nor automatic knowledge of underground activity.

profiles.compensates: Insufficient ferry and crossing infrastructure.

field_power.name: Surging Passage
field_power.effect: Redirect existing shallow water to disrupt one formation's footing or open a brief withdrawal lane.
field_power.range: One visible crossing in the local encounter
field_power.counter: Take higher ground, brace, delay the crossing or interrupt Ulmo.

support_power.name: Current-Borne Crossing
support_power.effect: Carry one normally loaded convoy across one surveyed water obstacle without a permanent ferry; no additional movement or cargo.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment; crew and normal convoy supplies
support_power.range: One connected region; one crossing
support_power.duration: One convoy passage during the week
support_power.counter: Contest either landing, obstruct access or force an alternative crossing.

passive.name: Reading the Flow
passive.effect: Inspection reveals the current crossing's flow and immediate navigational hazards.
passive.limit: Existing nearby water only; no enemy-location or future-weather guarantee.

profiles.retained_weakness: Dry divides, imported construction materials and limited transport crews still restrict expansion.

profiles.compensates: Low repair-workshop throughput.

field_power.name: Break the Brace
field_power.effect: Heavily damage one exposed cover piece or siege brace; never instantly destroy a hero or a complete fortified settlement.
field_power.range: Adjacent object in the local encounter
field_power.duration: One strike after a visible wind-up
field_power.counter: Screen the structure, interrupt the approach or build layered defenses.

support_power.name: Master's Repair
support_power.effect: Perform one normal repair job without its specialist workshop; the original repair recipe and crew requirements still apply.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + the repair's full tagged M cost
support_power.range: One worksite in one connected region
support_power.duration: One repair job during the week
support_power.counter: Disrupt material delivery, attack the worksite or spread damage across several sites.

passive.name: Sound Workmanship
passive.effect: At one personally inspected owned worksite, reduce the first routine wear event by one severity step.
passive.limit: One worksite per week; no reduction of combat damage, free repairs, material refunds or stacking.

profiles.retained_weakness: One excellent commission cannot replace food imports, extraction or a broad factory network.

profiles.compensates: Limited fortification-building capacity.

field_power.name: Root's Grasp
field_power.effect: Existing roots slow one formation crossing a marked patch; affected units can still fight or cut themselves free.
field_power.range: One rooted patch in the local encounter
field_power.counter: Cut or burn the roots, interrupt the casting or take another approach.

support_power.name: Living Buttress
support_power.effect: Turn existing mature vegetation into one temporary defensive barrier protecting a worksite; cannot harvest it for new M.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment; suitable living vegetation
support_power.range: One site in one connected region
support_power.duration: One week or until destroyed
support_power.counter: Use fire, cutting tools, siege attacks or an approach outside the barrier.

passive.name: Tread Lightly
passive.effect: Nearby allied travel causes less routine habitat damage.
passive.limit: Does not cancel harvesting, fire, construction damage or enemy destruction.

profiles.retained_weakness: Needs mature habitat and water; cannot instantly rebuild forests or support extensive metal industry.

profiles.compensates: Thin local guard coverage around vulnerable workplaces.

field_power.name: Declared Threshold
field_power.effect: Mark one narrow threshold; the first hostile formation crossing it loses momentum and becomes briefly slowed.
field_power.range: One visible threshold in the local encounter
field_power.counter: Go around, trigger it with a small detachment or interrupt the declaration.

support_power.name: Ward of Waiting
support_power.effect: Warn one staffed worksite of a direct approach and enable one organized evacuation; production stops when workers leave.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment; existing workers and evacuation route
support_power.range: One worksite in one connected region
support_power.duration: One week; one evacuation
support_power.counter: Block the exit, use concealed infiltration or threaten several worksites.

passive.name: Shelter of the Threshold
passive.effect: The first ordinary allied company withdrawing through an active Declared Threshold loses one fewer cohesion step.
passive.limit: Once per encounter; excludes Dragons and Balrogs. Does not prevent pursuit, damage or enemy passage.

profiles.retained_weakness: Cannot replace standing guards, broad food production or permanent defenses; grants no resurrection.

profiles.compensates: Limited military training facilities.

field_power.name: Drowsing Veil
field_power.effect: Disorient one formation in a small patch, reducing reaction speed without removing its ability to act.
field_power.range: One visible patch in the local encounter
field_power.counter: Raise an alarm, move out, interrupt the caster or have an ally rally the formation.

support_power.name: Rehearsal in Dream
support_power.effect: Prepare one existing company for one chosen contingency, reducing its first coordination penalty when that contingency occurs.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment; company's rest assignment and normal P upkeep
support_power.range: One resting company in one connected region
support_power.duration: Next encounter within one week; triggers once
support_power.counter: Interrupt rest, scout the preparation or force a different tactical situation.

passive.name: Lucid Adaptation
passive.effect: After a fresh verified scouting report, replace one company's prepared dream contingency without repeating its rest assignment.
passive.limit: Once per weekly preparation; replaces rather than adds a contingency. Its original expiry and single-use limit remain.

profiles.retained_weakness: Cannot manufacture equipment, train extra companies or substitute dreams for supplied troops.

profiles.compensates: Limited institutions for restoring cooperation after local losses.

field_power.name: Hold Fast
field_power.effect: Reduce one nearby allied formation's current panic by one step, allowing it to regroup or retreat.
field_power.range: One nearby allied formation in the local encounter
field_power.duration: Immediate recovery; later pressure applies normally
field_power.counter: Renew pressure, isolate the formation or interrupt Nienna before completion.

support_power.name: Council of Repair
support_power.effect: Resolve one recorded local grievance between willing parties after its negotiated restitution is actually delivered.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + agreed existing stocks or service
support_power.range: Two participating groups in one connected region
support_power.duration: One settlement during the week; new grievances remain possible
support_power.counter: Disrupt delivery, expose unfulfilled terms or continue the underlying injury.

passive.name: Leave None Uncounted
passive.effect: Keep known separated survivors visible in recovery planning after a nearby retreat.
passive.limit: Does not locate unknown survivors, revive deaths or recover anyone automatically.

profiles.retained_weakness: Care and restitution consume real capacity; grief generates no resources or permanent morale immunity.

profiles.compensates: Insufficient patrol-barracks coverage of wilderness routes.

field_power.name: Hunter's Interception
field_power.effect: Charge along an open approach to disrupt one attacking formation and briefly check its advance.
field_power.range: One formation reached by a clear local charge lane
field_power.counter: Brace, deploy stakes, block the lane or bait the charge into supporting fire.

support_power.name: Keep the Wild Road
support_power.effect: Personally patrol one marked route, producing warning reports and deterring minor harassment without a new barracks.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment; normal travel supplies
support_power.range: One route in one connected region
support_power.duration: One week
support_power.counter: Avoid the patrol, set an ambush or concentrate a force requiring an actual battle.

passive.name: Persistent Trail
passive.effect: Retain pursuit clues longer after personally observing a quarry's passage.
passive.limit: Known tracks only; weather, concealment and deliberate false trails still interfere.

profiles.retained_weakness: One hunter cannot guard every route, sustain a siege or replace local production.

profiles.compensates: Weak heavy-construction equipment and lifting capacity.

field_power.name: Unyielding Grapple
field_power.effect: Briefly restrain one adjacent opponent while Tulkas remains occupied; causes no automatic kill.
field_power.cost: 2 readiness; Tulkas cannot perform another action while maintaining it
field_power.range: One adjacent opponent in the local encounter
field_power.duration: Up to two beats; same opponent once per encounter
field_power.counter: Dodge the telegraphed approach, interrupt Tulkas or use allied attacks to break the hold.

support_power.name: Shoulder the Burden
support_power.effect: Replace a crane or lifting crew for one construction phase; all other labor, materials and building prerequisites remain.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + the phase's full tagged M cost
support_power.range: One worksite in one connected region
support_power.duration: One construction phase during the week
support_power.counter: Cut material delivery, attack the exposed site or force Tulkas to leave.

passive.name: Stand Beside Me
passive.effect: Nearby allies suffer a smaller first fear-induced coordination loss.
passive.limit: Once per encounter; does not prevent retreat, injury or later panic.

profiles.retained_weakness: Physical strength supplies neither materials nor advanced industry; dispersed threats still outnumber his interventions.

profiles.compensates: Limited evacuation and civilian-transfer infrastructure.

field_power.name: Impossible Step
field_power.effect: Lead one nearby ordinary allied formation through a short, rapid reposition along a visible traversable path; excludes all Dragons and Balrogs.
field_power.range: One nearby formation; short local path
field_power.counter: Block the path, prepare interceptors or burden the formation with cargo it cannot carry quickly.

support_power.name: Gather the Stragglers
support_power.effect: Organize one existing civilian group's transfer without a dedicated relay stable; actual destination consent and carrying limits apply.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + normal P travel rations
support_power.range: One known route in one connected region
support_power.duration: One transfer during the week
support_power.counter: Contest chokepoints, sever the route or force incompatible rescue priorities.

passive.name: Shared Pace
passive.effect: Groups personally accompanied by Nessa are less likely to separate on difficult ground.
passive.limit: Does not increase cargo, ignore barriers or protect against combat casualties.

profiles.retained_weakness: Speed cannot replace freight capacity, stocked refuges, fortified roads or manufacturing.

profiles.compensates: Limited nursery capacity and vulnerable agricultural timing.

field_power.name: Bloomscreen
field_power.effect: Existing shrubs flower densely enough to obscure one small patch and help a party change position.
field_power.range: One vegetated patch in the local encounter
field_power.counter: Use fire, cutting tools, elevated observation or another approach.

support_power.name: Season Brought Forward
support_power.effect: Advance one already planted plot by one growth stage; its predetermined harvest amount and remaining upkeep stay unchanged.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment; planted seed inputs, irrigation and tending labor
support_power.range: One plot in one connected region
support_power.duration: One growth-stage advance; once per crop cycle
support_power.counter: Damage irrigation, raid the field or interrupt tending; failed crops yield nothing.

passive.name: Signs of Renewal
passive.effect: Inspection identifies viable plants and whether a cultivated plot can recover.
passive.limit: Knowledge of condition only; creates no seeds, provisions or automatic recovery.

profiles.retained_weakness: Needs real fields, water and workers; cannot multiply harvests or accelerate mature forests.

profiles.compensates: Limited hospital beds and medical-workshop access.

field_power.name: Still the Wound
field_power.effect: Stabilize one living wounded target against immediate deterioration; it remains impaired and cannot instantly resume full combat.
field_power.range: One adjacent living target in the local encounter
field_power.duration: Until encounter end or renewed injury
field_power.counter: Interrupt treatment, separate healer and patient or inflict a new wound.

support_power.name: Rest Without Walls
support_power.effect: Treat one resting party as if a basic recovery facility were available, reducing one recoverable injury tier under normal care rules.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + normal P care supplies and any required medical M
support_power.range: One sheltered party in one connected region
support_power.duration: One week; one treatment result
support_power.counter: Interrupt rest, cut supplies or force the party to move.

passive.name: Care on the Road
passive.effect: One personally treated ordinary party preserves accumulated recovery progress through its first routine evacuation journey.
passive.limit: One party per week; normal travel costs and fatigue apply. New injury still disrupts care; no extra healing, readiness or resurrection.

profiles.retained_weakness: One party's recovery cannot absorb mass casualties; death and missing supply infrastructure remain consequential.

profiles.compensates: Fragile access to specialist production records after a workshop is lost.

field_power.name: Read the Broken Pattern
field_power.effect: Reconstruct one recent movement through inspected traces, producing a dated track rather than a live target marker.
field_power.range: One accessible trace site in the local encounter
field_power.duration: One report; becomes stale as units move
field_power.counter: Erase or overlay traces, leave decoys or attack during inspection.

support_power.name: The Remembered Workshop
support_power.effect: Let one basic workshop complete one previously unlocked faction item from a preserved plan despite losing its specialist archive.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + the item's full recipe and normal crew/time
support_power.range: One workshop in one connected region
support_power.duration: One week; unfinished work requires renewed commitment
support_power.counter: Destroy the preserved plan, interrupt the workshop or deny recipe inputs.

passive.name: Portable Chronicle
passive.effect: Carry a recoverable copy of one owned production plan or witnessed agreement.
passive.limit: No foreign recipes, hero recipes, unit commands, equipment copies or free K.

profiles.retained_weakness: Records cannot replace extraction, labor, surviving machinery or the rebuilding of an industrial network.

profiles.compensates: Expensive elite formations cannot replace losses quickly.

field_power.name: Harmonic Cover
field_power.effect: One own infantry company takes 25% less damage while holding formation; damage is never negated.
field_power.range: Local encounter; within the hero's audible radius
field_power.counter: Flank the company, separate it from the singer, or interrupt the hero.

support_power.name: Shared Rehearsal
support_power.effect: Advance one already-paid infantry training job that was started in an earlier turn by one weekly progress step; retain its queue and workers. A job started this turn is ineligible, so this power cannot start and finish a job in the same turn.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5K
support_power.range: One connected region containing the hero and training facility
support_power.duration: One weekly resolution; one job
support_power.counter: Disrupt supplies, close the route, or attack the training facility.

passive.name: Keep the Standard
passive.effect: One nearby own infantry company ignores its first formation-cohesion penalty from an allied retreat.
passive.limit: Once per encounter; casualties and other morale penalties still apply.

profiles.retained_weakness: Slow replacement, expensive equipment and limited army size remain.

profiles.compensates: Rare-input masterworks are costly to replace and their specialists are vulnerable.

field_power.name: Prismatic Flare
field_power.effect: A visible cone of radiance reduces ranged accuracy through it by 25%, including friendly fire.
field_power.range: Local encounter; short cone from the hero
field_power.counter: Change firing angle, wait out the flare, or close to melee.

support_power.name: Rework the Setting
support_power.effect: Restore up to 25% durability to one existing crafted item; cannot copy it, recover spent charges, or produce salvage.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 10M + 5K; compatible material access, staffed workshop and its repair queue required
support_power.range: One connected region; hero, workshop and item must be present
support_power.duration: One week; repair capped at maximum durability
support_power.counter: Contest the workshop, interrupt material delivery, or capture the item.

passive.name: Careful Setting
passive.effect: One own crafted item carried with the hero loses 25% less durability on its first ordinary wear event each week.
passive.limit: One item and one event per week; does not restore durability, spent charges or salvage value.

profiles.retained_weakness: Rare materials, occupied queues and specialist training still limit throughput.

profiles.compensates: Costly defenders must survive while defending dispersed approaches.

field_power.name: Shielded Withdrawal
field_power.effect: One own infantry company withdraws toward a chosen clear exit with 25% less pursuit damage; it still travels through the encounter.
field_power.range: Local encounter; company within command radius
field_power.counter: Block the exit, attack from another direction, or pursue with fresh troops.

support_power.name: Watch Rotation
support_power.effect: Two existing own garrisons exchange posts using an open road; their existing patrol coverage remains coordinated during transit. No new garrison or extra order is created.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment; normal movement orders and travel provisions required
support_power.range: Two posts in one connected region
support_power.duration: One week
support_power.counter: Cut the road, attack a moving garrison, or threaten a third approach.

passive.name: Measured Rearguard
passive.effect: One own formation near the hero recovers its facing immediately after an orderly withdrawal.
passive.limit: Once per encounter; no free movement, healing or attack.

profiles.retained_weakness: Few expensive formations cannot cover every pass or replace severe losses quickly.

profiles.compensates: Specialist recovery and cooperation require facilities, time and consent.

field_power.name: Song of Steadiness
field_power.effect: One own infantry company suppresses one fear penalty; existing casualties and movement restrictions remain.
field_power.range: Local encounter; within audible radius
field_power.counter: Separate the singers, interrupt the hero, or apply pressure from multiple directions.

support_power.name: Restorative Assembly
support_power.effect: One own company at a staffed refuge removes one noncritical wound condition one week sooner, never faster than one full week. Dead members do not return.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5P + 5K; occupied recovery queue and normal upkeep required
support_power.range: One connected region containing hero, refuge and company
support_power.duration: One week
support_power.counter: Threaten the refuge or interrupt its food and medicine route.

passive.name: Hospitality
passive.effect: One own company completing a normal paid rest assignment at the hero's staffed refuge removes one additional fatigue point.
passive.limit: Once per week; minimum zero fatigue. Normal rest time, queue and provisions remain; wounds and casualties are unchanged.

profiles.retained_weakness: Recovery is finite, training remains slow, and allies may refuse.

profiles.compensates: Valuable ships and transported specialists are exposed during coastal movement.

field_power.name: Sheltered Disembarkation
field_power.effect: One own transport unloads at a viable nearby landing with 25% less ranged damage during unloading; passengers are not immune.
field_power.range: Local coastal encounter; hero aboard or at the landing
field_power.counter: Occupy the beach, use flanking fire, or force the ship toward an unsuitable landing.

support_power.name: Beacon Passage
support_power.effect: One existing convoy on an observed coastal route ignores a single ordinary fog-navigation delay; ships still sail the full route.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5M for beacon fuel; existing staffed beacons, convoy order and provisions required
support_power.range: One connected coastal region
support_power.duration: One week; one convoy
support_power.counter: Extinguish a beacon, blockade the route, or intercept the convoy.

passive.name: Familiar Rigging
passive.effect: One own convoy accompanied by the hero ignores one ordinary handling-delay modifier on its first loading or unloading action each week.
passive.limit: One action per week; base handling time, cargo capacity, workers and material costs remain.

profiles.retained_weakness: Harbor dependence, limited inland influence and expensive hull replacement remain.

profiles.compensates: Hidden woodland defenses lose value once routes and companies are exposed.

field_power.name: Veil the Retreat
field_power.effect: One own woodland company moving between existing cover is harder to target at range; ranged accuracy against it falls 25%.
field_power.range: Local encounter; linked cover near the hero
field_power.counter: Enter the cover, illuminate the route, or attack its exposed destination.

support_power.name: Reweave the Watch
support_power.effect: Relocate one existing watch-post's concealment and observation equipment to a surveyed nearby site; the old post loses those functions.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5M; one worker project order and normal provisions required
support_power.range: One connected woodland region
support_power.duration: One week; only the completed new site remains active
support_power.counter: Track workers, patrol both sites, or remove surrounding cover.

passive.name: Border Memory
passive.effect: Detect a fresh crossing disturbance on a route the hero personally revisits.
passive.limit: One route per week; reveals neither identity nor exact troop count.

profiles.retained_weakness: Fire, lost woodland and sustained open combat still defeat concealment advantages.

profiles.compensates: Dispersed production and light companies depend on fragile woodland connections.

field_power.name: Rootwise Escape
field_power.effect: One own light infantry company ignores one ordinary woodland movement penalty while using an already passable route.
field_power.range: Local encounter; company near the hero
field_power.counter: Guard the exit, cut the route, or intercept on open ground.

support_power.name: Open the Old Trail
support_power.effect: Restore one obstructed existing woodland trail for light convoys; cannot create a route through cliffs or unbridged rivers.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5M for tools; one worker project order and normal provisions required
support_power.range: One connected woodland region surveyed by the hero
support_power.duration: One week to complete; trail persists and can be blocked again
support_power.counter: Patrol the trail, damage its waystations, or fell cover at a chokepoint.

passive.name: Light Footprint
passive.effect: The hero's accompanying light company leaves tracks that remain identifiable for one phase less.
passive.limit: Minimum one detectable phase; no effect on wagons, heavy formations or visible movement.

profiles.retained_weakness: Weak armor, poor open-field performance and dependence on living woodland remain.

profiles.compensates: Mobile workshops and decentralized settlements lack concentrated protection.

field_power.name: Rendezvous Signal
field_power.effect: Two own light companies near the hero synchronize their next retreat or advance without a coordination penalty; each spends its normal movement.
field_power.range: Local encounter; both companies within signal radius
field_power.counter: Block one route, separate the companies, or attack the signal position.

support_power.name: Traveling Compact
support_power.effect: Move one existing portable workshop and its staff between consenting own settlements without losing its stored work progress. It produces nothing while moving.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5P; normal transport order, carrying capacity and open route required
support_power.range: One connected region
support_power.duration: One week; travel must fit the normal route time
support_power.counter: Intercept the workshop or deny its destination and passage.

passive.name: Travel Rigs
passive.effect: One own portable workshop moving with the hero suffers 25% less durability loss from its first rough-road wear event each week.
passive.limit: One relocation event per week; combat damage, transport costs and destination setup requirements remain.

profiles.retained_weakness: Small workshops, limited armor and distance between settlements still constrain output.

profiles.compensates: Walls, armies and depots consume substantial metal and maintenance.

field_power.name: Brace the Breach
field_power.effect: Restore up to 15% structural durability to one damaged gate or barricade using an engineer company; cannot rebuild a destroyed structure.
field_power.cost: 2 readiness + 5M from a carried compatible repair kit; consumes the engineers' action
field_power.range: Local encounter; hero and engineers adjacent to the structure
field_power.duration: One action; repair cannot exceed maximum durability
field_power.counter: Attack the repair crew, interrupt access, or bypass the structure.

support_power.name: Supply Refit
support_power.effect: Repair up to 25% durability on one existing fortification or siege machine at a supplied depot; no ammunition or new unit is created.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 10M; matching material access, workers and one repair queue required
support_power.range: One connected region containing the hero, depot and target
support_power.duration: One week; capped at maximum durability
support_power.counter: Raid the depot, cut its supply road, or attack the repair site.

passive.name: Stable Bracing
passive.effect: One staffed own defensive structure beside the hero suffers 25% less durability loss from its first ordinary weather or maintenance-wear event each week.
passive.limit: One structure and one event per week; upkeep is paid normally. Combat damage and existing repair needs are unchanged.

profiles.retained_weakness: High material demand and weak coverage away from prepared positions remain.

profiles.compensates: Costly trained horses need fodder and lose effectiveness in broken terrain.

field_power.name: Relief Charge
field_power.effect: One own mounted company suppresses an exposed enemy infantry company's pursuit for one phase after a successful normal charge; casualties still resolve.
field_power.cost: 2 readiness; cavalry spends its normal charge action
field_power.range: Local encounter; viable charge lane within command radius
field_power.counter: Brace spears, occupy broken ground, or block the charge lane.

support_power.name: Remount Circuit
support_power.effect: Exchange tired mounts in one own rider company for an equal number of existing rested remounts at connected stables. Tired mounts remain and need normal recovery.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5P for handlers and fodder; remount stock and normal transfer order required
support_power.range: One connected region
support_power.duration: One week; no net new horses
support_power.counter: Raid the stables, intercept the transfer, or disrupt fodder supply.

passive.name: Careful Pacing
passive.effect: One own rider company traveling with the hero gains one less fatigue point on its first ordinary travel leg each week.
passive.limit: Minimum zero fatigue gain; no reduction in distance, travel time, fodder or combat fatigue.

profiles.retained_weakness: Mount production, fodder demand and poor charge terrain remain hard constraints.

profiles.compensates: Expensive fleets depend on harbors and vulnerable sea supply.

field_power.name: Coastal Landing
field_power.effect: One own marine company disembarks in organized formation rather than suffering the normal unloading cohesion penalty; it still uses a viable landing and normal movement.
field_power.range: Local coastal encounter; hero with the transport or landing force
field_power.counter: Fortify the landing, contest nearby water, or strike the transport before unloading.

support_power.name: Convoy Command
support_power.effect: Reassign existing escorts and cargo across up to three own ships without an organization delay; total cargo, escort strength and ship capacity do not increase.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5P for handling crews; normal voyage order and ship upkeep required
support_power.range: One connected coastal region with an accessible rendezvous harbor
support_power.duration: One week; actual loading and sailing time still applies
support_power.counter: Blockade the harbor, intercept the rendezvous, or force the convoy to split.

passive.name: Fixed Lashings
passive.effect: One own convoy carrying the hero loses 25% less existing cargo to its first minor storm-loss event each week.
passive.limit: One convoy and one event per week; creates no cargo, changes no capacity and does not protect against combat or catastrophic wrecking.

profiles.retained_weakness: Complex ship recipes, harbor loss and deep inland commitments remain costly.

profiles.compensates: Underground production relies on narrow entrances, ventilation and food imports.

field_power.name: Read the Fault
field_power.effect: Mark one observed unstable surface; an ordinary engineer attack against that obstacle gains 25% breach effectiveness. Occupied ground is not collapsed automatically.
field_power.cost: 2 readiness; engineer spends its normal action and tools
field_power.range: Local encounter; visible stone obstacle within short survey range
field_power.counter: Guard the obstacle, move away, or attack the surveying hero.

support_power.name: Restore the Airway
support_power.effect: Repair one existing blocked ventilation shaft or supply passage; restores its original capacity, never creates a new tunnel.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 10M for supports and tools; worker project order and safe access required
support_power.range: One connected underground region
support_power.duration: One week
support_power.counter: Contest shaft access, block the worksite, or raid its supplies.

passive.name: Pressure Sense
passive.effect: Warns of a worsening airflow problem in the hero's occupied tunnel section before its next ordinary production penalty.
passive.limit: One local warning per week; does not prevent the failure or detect enemy plans.

profiles.retained_weakness: Food imports, bottlenecks and the expense of genuinely new excavation remain.

profiles.compensates: Slow, metal-intensive companies are vulnerable when their protection mismatches the threat.

field_power.name: Fit the Guard
field_power.effect: One own armored infantry company takes 25% less damage from one selected ordinary hazard type after fitting a carried protection kit.
field_power.cost: 2 readiness + one existing protection kit; company spends its equipment action
field_power.range: Local encounter; company beside the hero
field_power.duration: Two tactical phases; only one fitted type at a time
field_power.counter: Switch damage type, flank the company, or wait out the temporary fitting.

support_power.name: Temper for the Threat
support_power.effect: Refit one existing company's armor for one declared hazard; improves that resistance by 20% while increasing equipment burden. Replaces its previous special fitting.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 10M + 5K; metal access, staffed workshop and its queue required
support_power.range: One connected region containing the hero, workshop and company
support_power.duration: One week to fit; persists until replaced or destroyed
support_power.counter: Use other attacks, exploit slower movement, or interrupt the refit.

passive.name: Field Care
passive.effect: One own armored company near the hero suffers 20% less armor-durability loss during its first encounter each week.
passive.limit: One company per week; incoming damage, fitting costs and pre-existing wear are unchanged. Durability is never restored.

profiles.retained_weakness: Heavy equipment, slow queues and the need to choose the right protection remain.

profiles.compensates: Rare inputs and specialist labor bottleneck tools and commissions.

field_power.name: Exact Breach
field_power.effect: One own engineer company's next obstacle attack gains 25% breach effectiveness when using an existing breach-tool set; its normal wear still applies.
field_power.cost: 2 readiness; normal engineer action and tool wear
field_power.range: Local encounter; hero beside engineers at the obstacle
field_power.counter: Defend the approach, damage the tools, or move the contested objective.

support_power.name: Modular Refit
support_power.effect: Convert one existing standard tool set to another already-researched compatible function. The original is consumed; rare or unique items are ineligible.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 10M + 5K; compatible inputs, staffed forge and one queue required
support_power.range: One connected region containing hero, forge and item
support_power.duration: One week; output keeps the input item's salvage-value ceiling
support_power.counter: Interrupt the forge, deny compatible materials, or force a different operational need.

passive.name: Calibrated Grip
passive.effect: One own engineer company beside the hero consumes 25% less breach-tool durability on its first ordinary obstacle attack each week.
passive.limit: One attack per week; normal attack action, tool requirements and recipe inputs remain. No resource refund or durability restoration.

profiles.retained_weakness: Rare commissions still require their full inputs, specialist queues and development time.

profiles.compensates: Large warbands consume food and divided command can destabilize operations.

field_power.name: Rally the Line
field_power.effect: One own Orc infantry company removes one temporary rout condition and reforms at its current position; wounds and casualty losses remain.
field_power.range: Local encounter; within the hero's command radius
field_power.duration: One reform phase; renewed pressure can rout it again
field_power.counter: Separate the hero, attack during reforming, or threaten another company.

support_power.name: Count the Spoils
support_power.effect: Advance one salvage job started in an earlier turn by one weekly progress step. Consume its finite claimed wreck once; normal salvage yield remains. A job started this turn is ineligible, so this power cannot start and finish a job in the same turn.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5P; assigned workers, project order and foundry queue required
support_power.range: One connected region with hero, wreck and receiving foundry
support_power.duration: One weekly resolution; one salvage job
support_power.counter: Recover or destroy the wreck, raid workers, or cut the return route.

passive.name: Declared Shares
passive.effect: One own participating warband avoids a dispute penalty when the player delivers an agreed reward on time.
passive.limit: One fulfilled agreement per week; reward is paid normally and existing grievances remain.

profiles.retained_weakness: Food demand, disputed leadership and finite salvage continue to constrain expansion.

profiles.compensates: Strong food production supports a community poorly suited to prolonged open battle.

field_power.name: Quiet Departure
field_power.effect: One own civilian or light-infantry group withdraws through existing cover with 25% lower ranged targeting accuracy against it; visibility is not erased.
field_power.range: Local encounter; group near hero and a viable covered exit
field_power.counter: Guard the exit, enter the cover, or attack the destination.

support_power.name: Neighbors' Stores
support_power.effect: Consolidate and move up to 10 existing P from willing own households to one refuge using available carriers; source stores lose the same amount.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 2P for transport; normal convoy order and carrying capacity required
support_power.range: One connected region with an open route
support_power.duration: One week; no stock duplication or capacity increase
support_power.counter: Block the road, intercept carriers, or threaten the receiving refuge.

passive.name: Packed for Rain
passive.effect: One supplied own civilian convoy accompanied by the hero ignores its first ordinary rain-fatigue increment each week.
passive.limit: One weather event per week; travel time, provisions, carrying capacity and all combat effects remain.

profiles.retained_weakness: Weak heavy forces, occupation risk and dependence on defensible refuge routes remain.

profiles.compensates: Heavy Troll forces need substantial supplies and struggle to bypass fortifications.

field_power.name: Measured Shatter
field_power.effect: The hero's next normal strike against a gate or barricade gains 25% breach effectiveness but exposes the hero to counterattack.
field_power.range: Local encounter; melee contact with the obstacle
field_power.counter: Use ranged focus, traps, a reserve barrier, or attacks during the exposed recovery.

support_power.name: Clear the Haulway
support_power.effect: Remove one ordinary fallen-stone or timber obstruction from an existing supply route. Cleared debris yields no resource stock.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5P + 5M for provisions and tool wear; worker project order required
support_power.range: One connected region; hero physically at the obstruction
support_power.duration: One week; does not create bridges or passages through mountains
support_power.counter: Contest the worksite, attack its supplies, or obstruct another route.

passive.name: Shoulder the Load
passive.effect: The hero carries one existing heavy equipment piece during ordinary movement without requiring a separate porter.
passive.limit: One item; it occupies carrying capacity and prevents sprinting. No added supply ceiling.

profiles.retained_weakness: Food consumption, slow repositioning and exposure to coordinated ranged forces remain.

profiles.compensates: Lightly protected packs rely on viable hunting territory and coordinated movement.

field_power.name: Split the Pursuit
field_power.effect: Two own wolf groups approaching from different passable directions impose one temporary pursuit penalty on a single isolated enemy company.
field_power.cost: 2 readiness; both groups spend their normal movement
field_power.range: Local encounter; groups within howling radius
field_power.counter: Close ranks, reach a defended crossing, or support the isolated company.

support_power.name: Read the Hunting Ground
support_power.effect: Survey one connected habitat for existing prey and recent danger; one normally assigned hunting group can choose its route using that report. Harvest still consumes finite prey.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 2P for the scouting pack; any hunt needs its normal separate order and upkeep
support_power.range: One connected habitat region physically traversable by the hero
support_power.duration: One week; report becomes stale as prey and threats move
support_power.counter: Patrol the hunting route, defend prey areas, or force movement through chokepoints.

passive.name: Recognized Scent
passive.effect: Distinguishes an own pack's recent trail from an unknown trail when the hero encounters it.
passive.limit: Fresh local traces only; reveals no remote position, identity or exact numbers.

profiles.retained_weakness: Finite prey, light protection, defended chokepoints and the lack of heavy industry remain.

profiles.compensates: A small refuge network cannot field enough troops to withstand a concentrated assault.

field_power.name: Flame of the White Fire
field_power.effect: After a visible wind-up, strike up to three exposed enemies in one 5-metre area with fire and light. Each takes damage equivalent to two of Gandalf's ordinary weapon hits, subject to normal defense; one selected victim also loses its current prepared ranged attack. The combined effect cannot kill a healthy hero or destroy a healthy capital in one use.
field_power.cost: 4 readiness and 10E; one local casting action within the battle commitment
field_power.range: One visible 5-metre area centred within 18 metres
field_power.duration: One-phase warning, then one burst; interruption affects only the currently prepared attack
field_power.counter: Disperse before the burst, take solid cover, interrupt the wind-up or close on Gandalf from another direction.

support_power.name: Stand of the Free
support_power.effect: Remove one fear step from up to two nearby friendly units and ward each against its next damaging hit. Each ward absorbs at most the damage of one of Gandalf's ordinary weapon hits; excess damage passes through. Wards do not restore health or change orders or allegiance.
support_power.cost: 2 readiness and 10K; one local casting action within the battle commitment
support_power.range: Two visible friendly units within 10 metres
support_power.duration: Two tactical phases or until each ward absorbs one hit; same wards do not stack
support_power.counter: Use repeated attacks, wait out the ward, separate its recipients or pressure an unprotected objective.

passive.name: Hope Rekindled
passive.effect: The first panic-driven rout of one owned ordinary company within 10 metres of Gandalf becomes an orderly fallback for one tactical phase, preserving its formation while it withdraws.
passive.limit: One company per encounter; does not heal, add movement or prevent later panic. Requires a traversable fallback route and Gandalf to remain conscious; excludes Dragons and Balrogs.

profiles.retained_weakness: His strongest burst consumes most of his six readiness and exposes a small army to pressure elsewhere. Refuge staff, provisions and ordinary troops remain necessary; protection has limited targets and duration.

profiles.compensates: A compact industrial enclave needs costly specialist defenders while workshops and workers are exposed.

field_power.name: Shattering Voice
field_power.effect: Release a directed sonic-force blow through a 3-metre-wide lane, striking at most two exposed units for damage equivalent to two of Saruman's ordinary weapon hits each. It also pushes each struck unit up to 3 metres along traversable ground; it cannot push across lethal edges. Normal defense applies, and one use cannot kill a healthy hero or destroy a healthy capital. This is physical force, not compelled obedience.
field_power.cost: 3 readiness, 5K and 5E; one local casting action within the battle commitment
field_power.range: One visible lane up to 16 metres long
field_power.duration: One-phase audible wind-up followed by one pulse
field_power.counter: Leave the lane, use solid barriers, brace against anchored cover to prevent the push, or interrupt Saruman before the pulse.

support_power.name: Commission the Iron Servant
support_power.effect: Create one ordinary Resonant Sentinel at a staffed Orthanc Workshop with a paid construct berth. It is an armed guard that may intercept one attack aimed at an adjacent ordinary ally per encounter, taking that attack's normal damage itself. It has no hero progression or hero slot. Creation occupies one ordinary queue for two turns and cannot attack in its completion resolution. This power cannot create, copy or command Dragons or Balrogs.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness and one weekly hero commitment at the start; 40M, 15K and 20E paid upfront; reserve 2 supply and 1 binding slot before work begins; upkeep 2M and 1E per turn after completion
support_power.range: One reachable staffed Orthanc Workshop in the connected region; Sentinel appears only at its berth
support_power.duration: Two production turns; at most one active or pending Sentinel from this power. It persists with upkeep until destroyed or deliberately dismantled; no material refund on dismantling
support_power.counter: Raid the workshop or interrupt staff and inputs before completion; afterwards flank the guard, attack from range or disrupt its upkeep. Shortages disable its special interception and block another commission, without changing ownership.

passive.name: Measured Demolition
passive.effect: One owned ordinary siege weapon within 12 metres of Saruman adds one ordinary-hit equivalent of its own damage to its first successful hit against a visible fortification in the encounter.
passive.limit: One weapon and one enhanced hit per encounter; ordinary action, ammunition, range and defense still apply. No extra shot, healthy-capital one-shot, or enhancement to a hero, Dragon or Balrog is granted.

profiles.retained_weakness: His three ordinary queues still share six support plots and supply 18. Industry, siege ammunition and his one bound Sentinel compete for materials and essence; his force lane needs positioning and offers no mass healing.

profiles.compensates: A habitat-dependent force cannot cheaply replace trained beasts and wounded defenders.

field_power.name: Wrath of Root and Thorn
field_power.effect: Drive living roots and thorns into up to two grounded enemies in one vegetated patch. Each suffers damage equivalent to two of Radagast's ordinary weapon hits, with normal defense, and its next movement is limited to one 3-metre step. Roots do not change allegiance; the combined strike cannot kill a healthy hero or destroy a healthy capital in one use.
field_power.cost: 3 readiness, 5P and 5E; one local casting action within the battle commitment
field_power.range: One visible 5-metre patch of living vegetation within 14 metres
field_power.duration: One-phase visible wind-up; damage once and movement restriction for the next tactical phase; normal two-phase disable reapplication grace applies
field_power.counter: Leave the growing roots during the warning, use paved or barren ground, cut or burn the roots, attack from range or take flight.

support_power.name: Mending of Living Flesh
support_power.effect: Heal one living friendly unit, including a hero, by an amount equal to two of Radagast's ordinary weapon hits of damage, capped at its missing health; also end one ordinary ongoing poison effect. It cannot resurrect, repair constructs, regrow a destroyed unit or remove a lasting campaign injury.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, 10P and 5E; one uninterrupted local treatment action within the battle commitment
support_power.range: Physical contact with one willing living patient
support_power.duration: One tactical phase of treatment; each patient can receive this healing once per encounter
support_power.counter: Interrupt contact, separate healer and patient, deny the required supplies or inflict fresh injuries after treatment.

passive.name: Companion's Vigil
passive.effect: One owned ordinary beast adjacent to Radagast may interpose against the first attack aimed at him in an encounter, taking the attack's normal damage instead.
passive.limit: Once per encounter; the beast must already be adjacent, conscious and under its existing ownership. No free movement, attack, damage immunity or new beast is granted; Dragons and Balrogs are excluded.

profiles.retained_weakness: Offense requires living vegetation and grounded targets. Healing consumes the same readiness needed for attack, and neither healing nor a bodyguard replaces lost habitats, destroyed units or a conventional siege force.

profiles.compensates: A small hunting force must defeat dangerous individual opponents before they overwhelm its scattered outposts.

field_power.name: Spear of the Far Hunt
field_power.effect: Launch one concentrated magical hunting strike at a visible enemy, dealing damage equivalent to three of Alatar's ordinary ranged weapon hits if it connects. Resolve normal armor and cover; a healthy hero or capital cannot be destroyed by this single strike. The attack is powerful against an exposed target but does not automatically hit or penetrate solid barriers.
field_power.cost: 4 readiness, 5K and 10E; one local casting action within the battle commitment
field_power.range: One visible enemy within 24 metres
field_power.duration: One-phase visible aiming warning followed by one strike
field_power.counter: Break sight with solid cover, move out of the firing lane during the warning, close on Alatar or interrupt his aim.

support_power.name: Quarry Sign
support_power.effect: Mark one currently visible enemy. Its outline remains observable through ordinary mist and light foliage within range, allowing pursuit after those forms of concealment. The mark reveals no other units, intentions or unseen terrain and gives no command over its target.
support_power.cost: 2 readiness and 5K; one local casting action within the battle commitment
support_power.range: One visible target within 24 metres; the mark stops providing information beyond that range
support_power.duration: Three tactical phases; ends if the target leaves range or removes the visible mark with one ordinary cleansing action
support_power.counter: Use solid walls, roofs or dense terrain that fully blocks sight; leave range, remove the mark or threaten Alatar while he pursues.

passive.name: Prepared Ambush
passive.effect: After one full tactical phase without moving or attacking, Alatar's next ordinary ranged attack gains one additional ordinary-hit equivalent of damage if it hits.
passive.limit: Once per encounter, on an ordinary attack only; never stacks onto Spear of the Far Hunt. Normal attack action, ammunition, cover and armor still apply; it cannot make a single hit kill a healthy hero.

profiles.retained_weakness: High-value single-target attacks do not clear a massed army or hold several outposts. Aiming and marking expose his position; walls, dense cover, close pressure and multiple simultaneous threats remain effective.

profiles.compensates: A lightly equipped resistance force cannot afford enough specialist equipment to withstand hostile battle magic.

field_power.name: Word of Sundering
field_power.effect: Strike one visible enemy with force equal to two of Pallando's ordinary weapon hits, subject to normal defense, and suppress one selected active cast ward or enchantment on it for two phases. One use cannot kill a healthy hero or destroy a healthy capital. Suppression never removes inherent abilities, destroys a created body, frees Anchor capacity, changes ownership or interrupts Melkor's command link to Dragons or Balrogs.
field_power.cost: 4 readiness, 10K and 5E; one local casting action within the battle commitment
field_power.range: One visible enemy within 18 metres; the chosen enchantment must already be identified
field_power.duration: One-phase spoken wind-up, damage once, then two-phase suppression; the original effect's duration and upkeep continue normally
field_power.counter: Take solid cover, interrupt the incantation, rely on ordinary weapons or armor, or outlast the short suppression before committing another spell.

support_power.name: Circle of Refusal
support_power.effect: Ward up to two friendly units inside a prepared 5-metre circle, reducing damage from direct hostile spells by half while they remain inside. It also shortens the next magical fear or silence imposed on each by one phase, to a minimum of one phase. Physical attacks, environmental fire and movement remain normal; this grants resistance rather than immunity or control over another faction's units.
support_power.cost: 2 readiness, 10K and 5E; one local casting action within the battle commitment
support_power.range: A 5-metre circle centred within 8 metres; select up to two friendly recipients
support_power.duration: Two tactical phases; ends for a recipient that leaves the circle; same-effect protection uses the strongest source only
support_power.counter: Use ordinary arrows or melee, destroy the visible ground markers, attack from outside the protected area or force the recipients to leave it.

passive.name: Unbroken Incantation
passive.effect: The first magical interruption of a spell Pallando is actively casting delays its completion by one tactical phase instead of cancelling it.
passive.limit: Once per encounter; a further interruption cancels normally. Lethal or incapacitating damage, lost range, lost target sight and physical displacement still invalidate the cast; costs are not refunded and no extra action or spell is created.

profiles.retained_weakness: His spell suppression is temporary and his protection covers only two units in a small fixed area. Ordinary armies, dispersed attacks and sustained physical pressure remain dangerous; essence and prepared lore supplies limit repeated casting.

profiles.compensates: Industrial armies lose effectiveness when their supply network is disrupted.

field_power.name: Black Command
field_power.effect: One owned ordinary company regains one lost cohesion step and can execute its declared fallback. Never affects Dragons or Balrogs.
field_power.range: One visible company within 12 metres in the current encounter
field_power.counter: Break line of sight, isolate the company or keep its fallback route blocked.

support_power.name: Redundant Supply
support_power.effect: Prepare an alternate route for one funded convoy between owned depots. It may reroute once when its original path closes; goods still travel normally.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, weekly hero commitment, 10M and 5K
support_power.range: One connected region with two owned depots and a surveyed open alternate route
support_power.duration: One week
support_power.counter: Block the alternate route, damage a depot or intercept the convoy.

passive.name: Reserved Rations
passive.effect: One selected owned ordinary company may carry up to 5P of paid reserve provisions beyond its normal load, reducing reliance on its next convoy.
passive.limit: Stocks must be deducted from a depot; upkeep consumes them normally. One company at a time; no Dragons or Balrogs.

profiles.retained_weakness: The army still needs provisions, depots and travel; exposed clients can secede.

profiles.compensates: Small support armies struggle to keep workers active near a threatening front.

field_power.name: Hold the Hearth
field_power.effect: Two nearby owned ordinary groups reduce their current panic by one step. Damage and fatigue remain.
field_power.range: Two groups within 8 metres of the Kindler in the current encounter
field_power.duration: Two tactical phases; one application per group per encounter
field_power.counter: Separate the groups, force the Kindler away or apply fresh pressure after the effect ends.

support_power.name: Refuge Shift
support_power.effect: Prepare shelter and an evacuation drill for one staffed worksite. Its workers can withdraw once to the selected nearby refuge; the abandoned job pauses rather than producing remotely.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, weekly hero commitment, 10P and 10M
support_power.range: One connected region; worksite and refuge linked by an open route
support_power.duration: One week or one evacuation
support_power.counter: Cut the route, occupy the refuge or force evacuation before the job completes.

passive.name: Shared Warmth
passive.effect: One ordinary company resting with the Kindler removes one additional fatigue step.
passive.limit: Once per week at a supplied refuge; no readiness, stock or injury restoration.

profiles.retained_weakness: Shelters cannot replace a field army, and displaced workers stop production.

profiles.compensates: Specialist training makes replacing injured personnel expensive.

field_power.name: Living Dressing
field_power.effect: Stabilize one nonfatal wound on an owned ordinary unit, preventing that wound worsening during withdrawal. Does not restore combat strength or revive the dead.
field_power.range: Physical contact in the current encounter
field_power.duration: Until encounter end or the unit suffers another wound
field_power.counter: Interrupt contact, deny a retreat route or inflict a new wound.

support_power.name: Nursery Recovery
support_power.effect: Treat up to two injured ordinary units at a staffed medicine nursery; each completes one additional step of its existing recovery schedule.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, weekly hero commitment, 10P and 10M
support_power.range: One connected region; patients physically present at the nursery
support_power.duration: This week's recovery resolution
support_power.counter: Raid the nursery, interrupt supplies or force the patients to move.

passive.name: Measured Remedies
passive.effect: One ordinary patient treated by Grovekeeper retains one already completed recovery step that would otherwise be lost during its first evacuation from the nursery.
passive.limit: One patient per week and once per injury; no new healing, readiness restoration, supply generation or resurrection.

profiles.retained_weakness: Care depends on viable habitat, staff and supplies; overwhelming losses still exhaust the order.

profiles.compensates: Fragile agents cannot afford repeated losses while gathering information.

field_power.name: Borrowed Shadow
field_power.effect: Place one stationary silhouette of an ordinary infantry scout to draw observation. It cannot attack, carry goods, capture sites or copy a hero, Dragon or Balrog.
field_power.range: One visible location within 12 metres in the current encounter
field_power.duration: Two tactical phases or until physically examined
field_power.counter: Scout from another angle, touch the silhouette or watch whether it interacts with terrain.

support_power.name: Quiet Exchange
support_power.effect: Cross-check one dated report through two staffed safehouses, identifying contradictions and source uncertainty. It does not reveal unobserved facts.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, weekly hero commitment and 10K
support_power.range: One connected region containing both safehouses
support_power.duration: One report delivered at weekly resolution
support_power.counter: Close a safehouse, intercept its courier or supply independently consistent false evidence.

passive.name: Compartmented Contacts
passive.effect: Capture of one ordinary agent reveals only that agent's current assignment and contacts.
passive.limit: Does not conceal information already learned elsewhere or automatically rescue the captive.

profiles.retained_weakness: The order lacks durable troops, and deception cannot substitute for holding ground.

profiles.compensates: A small number of expensive constructs makes repair downtime costly.

field_power.name: Brace the Mechanism
field_power.effect: Restore one movement impairment on an owned nonhero construct made by this order. No lost unit is recreated, and destroyed parts remain destroyed.
field_power.range: Physical contact in the current encounter
field_power.duration: Until encounter end or another disabling hit
field_power.counter: Interrupt the repair, separate the Artificer from the machine or damage the repaired joint.

support_power.name: Service Overhaul
support_power.effect: Advance one already-funded repair job by one turn. It cannot complete in the turn it starts; excludes hero creation, new-unit production, Dragons and Balrogs.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, weekly hero commitment, 15M and 5K
support_power.range: One staffed service depot in the connected region
support_power.duration: One repair job; once per job
support_power.counter: Occupy the depot, remove its crew or deny its required source access.

passive.name: Standard Fittings
passive.effect: An ordinary repair kit made by this order fits any of its own ordinary constructs.
passive.limit: Every repair still consumes the kit, materials and its normal action; never grants another faction's recipe.

profiles.retained_weakness: Constructs remain material-intensive, and repair cannot compensate for destroyed production facilities.

profiles.compensates: A dispersed small army often receives warnings too late to concentrate.

field_power.name: Signal Flash
field_power.effect: One visible owned ordinary group may revise its declared fallback before the next tactical resolution; its movement allowance does not increase.
field_power.range: One group within 15 metres in the current encounter
field_power.counter: Obscure the signal, block the fallback or pressure a different group.

support_power.name: Beacon Concord
support_power.effect: Prepare one verified warning relay between three staffed beacons. An observed attack is reported at the next planning phase, without revealing events outside their sightlines.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, weekly hero commitment, 10M and 5K
support_power.range: One connected region with an intact beacon chain
support_power.duration: One week
support_power.counter: Cut a relay, approach under cover or use a diversion beyond its sightlines.

passive.name: Veiled Starlight
passive.effect: One staffed beacon link previously surveyed by Wayseer can transmit one already-observed warning through light fog that would normally block its visual signal.
passive.limit: Once per week across one link; normal actions, staffing, costs, range and delivery time apply. No extra messages, improved observation, passage through solid cover or transmission through heavy fog or storms.

profiles.retained_weakness: Knowledge does not create troops or transport; unconnected regions remain difficult to protect.

profiles.compensates: A stationary sanctuary depends on vulnerable trips beyond its protected boundary.

field_power.name: Veil the Departing
field_power.effect: Conceal the visible trail of one consenting ordinary party while it withdraws. Attacking or crossing open ground ends the concealment.
field_power.range: One party within 10 metres in a wooded encounter
field_power.counter: Watch exits, inspect fresh tracks from another angle or force the party into open terrain.

support_power.name: Guest Road
support_power.effect: Ward one surveyed wooded supply route against casual observation. Convoys still require transport, provisions and ordinary travel time.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, weekly hero commitment, 10M, 5K and one Anchor
support_power.range: One connected region adjoining the sanctuary
support_power.duration: One week; ends early if its prepared markers are destroyed
support_power.counter: Patrol the route closely, clear cover or seize an endpoint.

passive.name: Known Thresholds
passive.effect: One staffed sanctuary entrance records arrivals and departures for later inspection.
passive.limit: One entrance at a time; cannot identify a concealed identity or observe outside the boundary.

profiles.retained_weakness: Protection remains stationary and cannot solve internal disputes or sustain distant armies.

profiles.compensates: Coastal workshops and landings lose productive access when channels are obstructed.

field_power.name: Break the Landing
field_power.effect: Raise hazardous surf across one short landing approach, slowing ships and swimmers physically. Friendly vessels face the same hazard.
field_power.range: One visible coastal strip within 15 metres in the current encounter
field_power.counter: Use another beach, wait out the surf or approach from land.

support_power.name: Workable Tide
support_power.effect: Help a supplied shore crew clear one silted or debris-blocked harbor channel, completing one step of its funded repair. No new harbor or ship is created.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, weekly hero commitment and 20M
support_power.range: One owned harbor in a connected coastal region
support_power.duration: This week's repair resolution
support_power.counter: Disrupt the shore crew, damage its equipment or renew the physical obstruction.

passive.name: Read the Shoals
passive.effect: Inspection reveals safe draft and current hazards for one local channel.
passive.limit: One inspected channel per week; information becomes stale after storms or sabotage.

profiles.retained_weakness: Inland threats remain difficult to answer, and storm magic endangers friendly shipping.

profiles.compensates: Small maritime forces cannot replace damaged transport quickly.

field_power.name: Stillwater Pocket
field_power.effect: Reduce wave hazard by one severity step around one damaged vessel so its crew can attempt repair or rescue. Enemy attacks remain effective.
field_power.range: One vessel within 15 metres in the current encounter
field_power.counter: Attack from shore, obstruct its route or force it beyond the calm pocket.

support_power.name: Sheltered Refit
support_power.effect: A staffed rescue yard advances repairs on one existing transport by one step while Uinen maintains workable water conditions.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, weekly hero commitment, 10P and 15M
support_power.range: One rescue yard in a connected coastal region
support_power.duration: This week's repair resolution; once per repair job
support_power.counter: Blockade the yard, interrupt materials or raid the repair crew.

passive.name: Ready Lifelines
passive.effect: One prepared friendly rescue craft can begin a rescue without first deploying its rigging.
passive.limit: One rescue per encounter; normal load, movement and casualty limits still apply.

profiles.retained_weakness: She cannot replace destroyed fleets or secure inland supply lines through calming water alone.

profiles.compensates: A small terrestrial workforce struggles to operate under hostile concealment.

field_power.name: Unclouded Glimpse
field_power.effect: Thin ordinary smoke or mist in one visible area, exposing silhouettes without identifying hidden motives or targets behind solid cover.
field_power.range: One 6-metre area within 15 metres in the current encounter
field_power.counter: Use roofs, tunnels, solid cover or fresh smoke outside the illuminated area.

support_power.name: Dawn Worksite
support_power.effect: Illuminate one prepared worksite so its existing crew can perform its normal shift despite darkness. No extra production cycle, workers or free materials are granted.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, weekly hero commitment, 10M and 5K
support_power.range: One connected region; one staffed site with a maintained mirror station
support_power.duration: One week
support_power.counter: Destroy the mirrors, attack the exposed crew or obstruct the sightline with solid cover.

passive.name: Long Shadows
passive.effect: An occupied dawn watchpost records the direction of exposed movement crossing its lit approach.
passive.limit: One selected post; only visible movement, with no tracking after cover is reached.

profiles.retained_weakness: Illumination cannot hold territory, enter sealed interiors or replace conventional defense.

profiles.compensates: Limited patrol numbers leave nocturnal routes poorly covered.

field_power.name: Silver Interception
field_power.effect: Make one aimed attack against an exposed attacker preparing to strike a nearby ordinary ally. It can interrupt that attack but cannot guarantee a kill.
field_power.range: One visible target within 15 metres in the current encounter
field_power.counter: Use cover, feint with one attacker and strike with another, or engage beyond the protected lane.

support_power.name: Watch of the Moon
support_power.effect: Survey one declared night route personally and report observed crossings at the next planning phase. It does not reveal interiors or unvisited branches.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, weekly hero commitment and 10P for supporting scouts
support_power.range: One connected region and one traversable patrol route
support_power.duration: One week
support_power.counter: Travel outside the route, use overhead cover or stage a diversion.

passive.name: Night Bearings
passive.effect: One ordinary scout group accompanying Tilion reduces a routefinding delay by one tactical phase when retracing a route he personally surveyed.
passive.limit: Once per encounter; does not bypass blockades, increase movement allowance or disclose new terrain.

profiles.retained_weakness: A single patrol cannot protect multiple fronts, and dependable reports still require exposure.

profiles.compensates: A compact expeditionary economy struggles with dispersed military commitments.

field_power.name: Heralds Advance
field_power.effect: Lead up to two owned ordinary companies in a coordinated advance, reducing separation by allowing a shared pace. Movement and damage remain otherwise normal.
field_power.range: Two companies within 10 metres in the current encounter
field_power.counter: Block their shared route, attack their flanks or force different terrain speeds.

support_power.name: Muster by Terms
support_power.effect: Prepare one rally point and timed arrival plan for three owned ordinary companies. They retain separate travel requirements and can join one declared operation when they arrive.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, weekly hero commitment, 15P and 10M
support_power.range: One connected region with surveyed routes and a supplied rally point
support_power.duration: One week
support_power.counter: Intercept one route, deny the rally point or draw the force toward another objective.

passive.name: Clear Commission
passive.effect: One supplied ordinary company operating under his written mission retains its declared fallback if communications are cut.
passive.limit: One company and one mission; cannot issue new orders remotely or apply to Dragons or Balrogs.

profiles.retained_weakness: Concentrating the host exposes other routes, and his martial strength cannot replace provisions.

profiles.compensates: A lightly defended communications network is easily disrupted.

field_power.name: Witness Flare
field_power.effect: Mark the observed position of one visible attacker for nearby defenders. The mark does not follow the target after it reaches cover.
field_power.range: One visible target within 15 metres in the current encounter
field_power.counter: Change position under cover, obscure the flare or attack from another direction.

support_power.name: Second Signal
support_power.effect: Prepare a redundant physical relay for one staffed communications link. If its primary station fails, a courier can use the surveyed alternate route.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, weekly hero commitment, 15M and 5K
support_power.range: One connected region with an available courier and alternate route
support_power.duration: One week or one rerouted message
support_power.counter: Intercept the courier, block the alternate route or feed false reports into the surviving station.

passive.name: Witness Chain
passive.effect: The first report crossing her network each week preserves the identities of its observed relay stations and its timestamp.
passive.limit: Provenance supports checking, not guaranteed truth; generates no fresh observations.

profiles.retained_weakness: Reliable communications still need staffed sites and cannot substitute for a defending army.

profiles.compensates: Slow movement makes separated habitats and work areas difficult to defend.

field_power.name: Rooted Screen
field_power.effect: Raise existing roots across one short approach, slowing passage and sheltering withdrawal without sealing every exit.
field_power.range: One rooted area within 10 metres in the current encounter
field_power.counter: Cut or burn the roots, use a different approach or attack from range.

support_power.name: Living Causeway
support_power.effect: Shape existing timber and roots into one short crossing for ordinary movement. Requires a working crew and suitable banks; does not create mature trees.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, weekly hero commitment, 20M and 10P
support_power.range: One connected region; a surveyed gap no wider than 15 metres
support_power.duration: Completed physical crossing persists until damaged
support_power.counter: Attack the builders, burn the crossing or block its far bank.

passive.name: Root Memory
passive.effect: Once per week, inspect one connected grove for recent logging or heavy passage and identify its direction.
passive.limit: Records disturbance rather than identities; disconnected land remains unknown.

profiles.retained_weakness: The faction remains slow, habitat-dependent and vulnerable to sustained fire.

profiles.compensates: Secure aerial territory still has little capacity to move supplies or rescue grounded allies.

field_power.name: Lift the Stranded
field_power.effect: Carry one willing light nonhero ally to a safe landing point. Excludes large creatures, Dragons and Balrogs; both take the risk of the exposed flight.
field_power.range: Pickup by contact; landing within 20 metres in the current encounter
field_power.duration: One flight across two tactical phases
field_power.counter: Guard the landing point, use ranged attacks or deny sufficient landing space.

support_power.name: Eyrie Relay
support_power.effect: Move up to 20 units of existing P or K between two prepared ledges using one committed ordinary flight. It cannot transport M, E, troops or a second load.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, weekly hero commitment, 10P and 5M
support_power.range: Two owned or consenting ledges within one connected region
support_power.duration: One delivery at weekly resolution
support_power.counter: Threaten a ledge, intercept the flight or force weather delays.

passive.name: Landing Survey
passive.effect: Before one rescue or delivery each week, reveal visible obstacles and available space at the inspected destination.
passive.limit: Requires line of sight; concealed defenders remain concealed.

profiles.retained_weakness: Loads stay small, eyries remain exposed, and air superiority does not establish ground control.

profiles.compensates: A prey-dependent economy struggles to connect separated lairs safely.

field_power.name: Layered Snare
field_power.effect: Web one short approach, reducing ordinary ground movement through it and revealing physical crossings. It does not issue orders or permanently immobilize targets.
field_power.range: One 6-metre approach within 10 metres in the current encounter
field_power.duration: Three tactical phases or until cleared
field_power.counter: Cut or burn the web, cross elsewhere or attack from range.

support_power.name: Brood Bridge
support_power.effect: Build one silk crossing between prepared anchors, opening a route for ordinary brood workers and hunters. Hunting and transport still require their normal assignments.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness, weekly hero commitment, 20M and 10P
support_power.range: One connected region; a surveyed gap no wider than 15 metres
support_power.duration: Physical crossing persists until damaged
support_power.counter: Destroy an anchor, clear the crossing or ambush its exit.

passive.name: Tremor Ledger
passive.effect: One occupied lair records the time and direction of crossings touching its connected web routes.
passive.limit: No identity detection, remote control or information beyond intact connected silk.

profiles.retained_weakness: The brood still depends on prey and prepared terrain; fire and cleared routes remain effective counters.

profiles.compensates: A tiny sanctuary cannot maintain broad industry or replace a large army.

field_power.name: Worldbreak
field_power.effect: Damage one defended obstacle or clustered position after a visible wind-up; cannot destroy a healthy hero or capital in one use.
field_power.range: One visible local encounter position
field_power.duration: One attack after a one-phase warning
field_power.counter: Disperse, use layered barriers, interrupt the approach or attack another objective.

support_power.name: Call of the Dark
support_power.effect: Activate one discovered, living Balrog or Dragon with an existing map ID. It walks or flies from its real location; no new entity, hatching or resurrection is created.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 20P + 20M + 10E; reserve full supply and great-creature points; normal movement operations thereafter
support_power.range: One discovered candidate with a known traversable route; no teleportation
support_power.duration: One call; arrival follows actual travel time
support_power.counter: Scout its departure, block or intercept the route, or kill the finite candidate before deployment.

passive.name: Unspent Might
passive.effect: Maximum readiness is 12 and a recovery commitment restores 6, enabling more personal intervention.
passive.limit: One hero commitment per week; sanctuary supply 12 and great-creature capacity 2 remain fixed. It grants no new creature production or extra map presence.

profiles.retained_weakness: Small economy, limited simultaneous coverage and a finite, nonrenewable pool of living Balrogs and Dragons.

profiles.compensates: Expensive creature industry matures slowly and needs coordination across vulnerable sites.

field_power.name: Iron Edict
field_power.effect: Coordinate a synchronized plan for up to three owned great creatures on one connected front; no additional attacks, movement or foreign control.
field_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment; units retain normal movement and supply requirements
field_power.range: One connected front with surveyed routes
field_power.duration: One weekly operation; plans resolve through ordinary tactical phases
field_power.counter: Divide the front, block one route, interrupt preparation or threaten an uncovered city.

support_power.name: Forge Will
support_power.effect: Advance one fully paid, staffed production job by one turn; cannot finish in the turn it starts and cannot create duplicate outputs.
support_power.cost: 3 readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 10E; all original inputs, workers, capacity and facility remain required
support_power.range: One reachable owned worksite in one connected region
support_power.duration: One job at one weekly resolution; at most once per turn
support_power.counter: Raid the facility, deny inputs, displace workers or destroy the job before completion.

passive.name: Brood Discipline
passive.effect: After research, reduce future Dragon/Balrog base production time by 25%, rounded up; costs do not fall.
passive.limit: Unlock costs 60M + 40K + 30E and three research turns. Six ordinary queues maximum, full reservations and upkeep; never applies to hero recreation.

profiles.retained_weakness: Lower personal combat capacity, slower economic setup and expensive, exposed production. Existing-creature calls remain available at the same cost; new Dragons and Balrogs require this doctrine.
